name: Out of the 7 scale degrees in a minor scale:
use_when: Chọn gam / scale để ngẫu hứng jazz
avoid_when: Đệm hát ballad Việt — đây là gam jazz, không phải bài của thầy Hải Joseph

output.source_text: Out of the 7 scale degrees in a minor scale: Degree 1 cannot change (changes tonality); Degree 2 can only be flattened (b2, since #2 = b3); Degree b3 cannot change (defines minor quality); Degree 4 can only be sharpened (#4, since b4 = 3); Degree 5 can be flattened (b5) or sharpened (#5); Degree 6 can be flattened (b6) or sharpened (#6); Degree 7 can only be flattened (b7, since #7 = root).

note_vi: Bài 33 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 00:38-01:55.
